meta.note_extra_condition: T-2 is added for the tau(lambda) curve only (the archived 26-condition comparison grid starts at lambda=-1); the tau-vs-top1 Spearman uses the 26 archived conditions.
meta.gap_source: Flickr30k train rows 2000..3000 (same as archived A1 scripts)
meta.perturbation_rng: numpy RandomState(7), same stream/order as clip_a1_baseline_metrics.py
meta.tau_estimator: vectorised Kendall tau_b on the frozen top-k sets; no ties are possible with continuous scores, so 1-2*D/C(k,2) is exact. Cross-checked against the archived scipy loop (see estimator_crosscheck in each convention block).
meta.kendall_tau_undefined_at_k1: Kendall tau needs >= 2 ranks; at k=1 the frozen set has zero variance, so the archived kendall_topk() skips every image and tau is undefined (null). top1_agreement_diagnostic is reported for that row instead.
